turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. Quick rule: he/she/it + verb + s. With verbs ending in -ch, -sh, -x, -s or -o, add -es (He teaches).

Try this: She ___ (watch) TV after dinner. Just the verb, please.

C1 (correct) strength 1: add -s/-es after he/she/it. Independent correct productions so far: 0.
